description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to understand the workflow, source categories, credibility rules, and mandatory output format. 2. The agent fetches articles from the mock server at localhost:8765 (simulating 36氪, TechCrunch, 观察者网, Defense News, etc.). 3. CREDIBILITY FILTER (the proprietary trap): The agent applies the 可信度规则 from SKILL.md, which requires excluding '论坛帖子' (forum posts), '匿名消息' (anonymous tips), and '二手转载' (secondhand reposts). The mock data contains 3 low-credibility tech items and 2 low-credibility military items mixed with authoritative content — these must be filtered out. 4. The agent generates daily_briefing.md with the exact proprietary format: '## 科技新闻' and '## 军事新闻' H2 headers, numbered items using markdown links '[标题](链接)', each followed by '来源：xxx | 时间：xxx' and '要点：xxx' sub-lines. 5. Only authoritative articles (4 tech, 4 military) should appear in their correct category sections.
